notes: ILCE-7SM3 (Alpha 7S III) is Sony's 12MP high-sensitivity video-focused full-frame hybrid. Listed in initial PTP3 compatibility. Has S&Q (slow and quick) and HFR recording capability. Has Picture Profile (PP1-PP11 including S-Log2, S-Log3, HLG). Dual CFexpress Type A / SD slots. No cinema properties (no ND filter, no shutter angle). FTP transfer supported. The ILCE-7SM3 is notable for video work but does not have the cinema-specific properties of the FX line.
